clue.text: Student given job — to put things in order around University

parts.note: a post is a job or position

indicators.note: the ordering verb's letters go around the abbreviation for University

parts.note: to gradate is to arrange things in grades or steps

explanation.surface: A student is handed a job tidying up around the campus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' signals the container; 'given' is only a link. Gradate, to arrange in grades, is a less familiar verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone doing a higher degree after a first one is a kind of student.

clue.text: To which southerners may travel very quickly north

parts.note: presto is the musical direction meaning very fast

explanation.surface: Southerners speed up the country heading north.
explanation.walkthrough: PRESTON is a town in Lancashire, in the north of England, so southerners head there.
explanation.definitionFit: A northern English town is a destination for travellers from the south.

clue.text: Beauties have no right 'to cause accidents

indicators.note: the word for beauties is left without one of its letters

parts.note: smashers is British slang for very attractive people

explanation.surface: Glamorous people are blamed for causing crashes.
explanation.definitionFit: Smashes are crashes, collisions in which vehicles are wrecked.

clue.text: Bolt-hole for inexperienced Othello when upset

parts.note: green means new and inexperienced

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means the word is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: Othello is Shakespeare's Moor of Venice

explanation.surface: A naive Othello, distraught, looks for somewhere to hide.
explanation.walkthrough: A green room is the backstage lounge where actors retreat, apt for a theatrical character.
explanation.definitionFit: A green room is a retreat for performers offstage, a place to escape to.

clue.text: The affair of a second Chaldean city

parts.note: mo is a short moment, a second
Ur was the ancient city of the Chaldees in Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A love affair conducted in an ancient Mesopotamian city.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word for love is used in English for a romantic liaison.

clue.text: Of varying quality, unlike Orwell's farm animals

definitions.meaning: in Animal Farm all animals are said to be equal

explanation.surface: Patchy work, quite unlike the creatures of Animal Farm.
explanation.definitionFit: Patchy work is not the same throughout, and Orwell's animals were all declared alike in status.

clue.text: Air passage for ambassador trapped when a vehicle overturns

indicators.note: the ambassador's letters are caught inside the overturned vehicle
in a down clue, overturns means the words are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a cart is a simple vehicle
HE stands for His Excellency, an ambassador's title

explanation.surface: An envoy is pinned when his carriage tips over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturns' reads the vehicle phrase upwards to give TRACA, and 'trapped' sets His Excellency inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The windpipe is the tube carrying breath to the lungs.

clue.text: Collections of notes hidden in Nero's day, misplaced for ages

indicators.note: the musical collections sit inside the rearranged letters
misplaced letters are put in the wrong order

parts.note: the possessive s counts as a letter here
keys in music are sets of notes forming a scale

explanation.surface: Notes buried somewhere in Nero's time, lost for a long while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misplaced' rearranges the eight letters of the emperor's day into DON YEARS, and 'hidden in' sets the musical scales inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Donkey's years is a British idiom for a very long time.

clue.text: Hold forth about gymnastics training to produce an effect

indicators.note: the speech word goes around the school-exercise abbreviation

parts.note: to orate is to speak at length
PE is physical education, school gym lessons

explanation.surface: Someone lectures on gym coaching to make an impact.
explanation.definitionFit: To work or function is to act so as to bring about a result.

clue.text: Acquire too many weapons in such a delivery?

definitions.meaning: a bowl in cricket with the arm above the shoulder

explanation.surface: Building up an arsenal through a bowling action.
explanation.definitionFit: Arming beyond need is excessive militarisation, and in cricket a bowl from above the shoulder has that name.

clue.text: Mimic girl at sea, initially cack-handed with this tool

parts.note: to monkey is to ape or imitate
a Wren is a member of the Women's Royal Naval Service

indicators.note: the opening letters of both parts of the hyphenated word

explanation.surface: A clumsy sailor girl copies someone using a spanner.
explanation.walkthrough: Both halves of 'cack-handed' (British slang for clumsy) give their first letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An adjustable spanner is a tool for gripping nuts.

clue.text: Boy nursing restless desire for drums

indicators.note: the boy's name holds the other word inside like a nursed child

parts.note: Ken is a boy's name
an itch is a restless craving

explanation.surface: A lad harbours an urge to play percussion.
explanation.walkthrough: Kitchen is orchestral slang for the percussion section.
explanation.definitionFit: The percussion section of an orchestra is nicknamed after the room for cooking, for its pots and pans.

clue.text: Tailless red bird has become wild

indicators.note: the colour word loses its last letter

parts.note: rouge is French for red, and red make-up
a hen is a bird

explanation.surface: A red bird missing its tail has gone feral.
explanation.definitionFit: To make or become coarse and unkempt is to go wild in texture.

clue.text: 7 hit high return round the leg side

indicators.note: the reversed hit goes around the cricket side
return means the word is read backwards

parts.note: to sky a ball is to hit it high
in cricket the leg side is also called the on side

explanation.surface: A cricketer skies a shot back towards leg.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to 7 down, DONKEY'S YEARS. 'return' makes YKS, which goes round ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British words for a very long time.

clue.text: Swing seen as harmful in East Coast resort

indicators.note: the harmful word sits inside the rearranged letters
read as re-sort, the letters are sorted again into a new order

parts.note: ill can mean harmful, as in ill effects

explanation.surface: A seaside town on the east coast is thought to be bad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' is the anagram signal: re-sort ECOAST to OSCATE, with ILL placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To move to and fro like a pendulum is to sway back and forth.

clue.text: Study French writer on river vessel

parts.note: to con is to study or learn
Hippolyte Taine was a French critic and historian

explanation.surface: A scholar reads a French author beside a river boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A receptacle that holds something is a vessel.

clue.text: Chants may need revision for Chichester, say

indicators.note: words needing revision are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: Songs may have to be rewritten for a famous sailor.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Francis Chichester sailed single-handed round the world; Chichester is also a cathedral city, a distraction.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Chichester was a celebrated lone sailor, an example of a sailing enthusiast.

clue.text: Colour of animal carrying sun god

indicators.note: the animal holds the god within it as cargo

parts.note: a camel is an animal
Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A camel carries an Egyptian deity, its hide a certain shade.
explanation.definitionFit: Light toffee brown is a shade named after burnt sugar.

clue.text: Opportunity to support strike in the bar

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece is written below the other

parts.note: to tap is to strike lightly
room means scope or opportunity, as in room for improvement

explanation.surface: A chance to back the walkout comes in the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A taproom is the public bar of an inn.

clue.text: Scolding woman, endlessly cunning

indicators.note: the word loses its final letter, so it has no end

parts.note: shrewd means sharp and cunning

explanation.surface: A nagging woman is sly to no end.
explanation.definitionFit: A nagging, bad-tempered woman, as in The Taming of the play's heroine.

clue.text: Bird, or butterfly without tail

indicators.note: the second clue word is taken away from the butterfly's name

parts.note: the swallowtail is a large butterfly

explanation.surface: Is it a bird, or a butterfly missing its rear?
explanation.definitionFit: A fork-tailed migratory songbird.

clue.text: Duty list for keeper of duck and cockerel

indicators.note: the list keeps the other piece inside it

parts.note: a roster is a rota of duties
a duck in cricket is a score of nought, O

explanation.surface: A rota for whoever tends the poultry.
explanation.definitionFit: A male domestic fowl is called a cockerel in Britain.

clue.text: Concerning public relations work in Laos? Not the capital

indicators.note: the publicity and work pieces go inside the trimmed country
the capital letter of the country name is dropped

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: PR work in Laos, but not in Vientiane?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not the capital' looks like Vientiane, but it means the capital letter L.
explanation.definitionFit: With regard to, on the subject of.

clue.text: Downfall of a general, in a way?

indicators.note: the general goes inside the abbreviation for street

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general

explanation.surface: A general's fall from grace, in a manner of speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Icy rain is a fall from the sky, a precipitation.

clue.text: Mollusc discovered by Jack without assistance

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, as is AB, able seaman
alone means unaided

explanation.surface: A sailor finds a shellfish all by himself.
explanation.definitionFit: An edible sea snail with an ear-shaped shell lined with mother-of-pearl.

clue.text: Amount gained, it's said, by a certain person

indicators.note: the phrase is spoken aloud to give the answer's sound

parts.note: a sum is an amount and won means gained

explanation.surface: A certain individual earned a sum, reportedly.
explanation.definitionFit: An unnamed individual, somebody.

clue.text: Like a blue or white flower

definitions.text: Like a blue or white flower

parts.words: Like a blue or white flower
parts.note: a flower is read as something that flows, a river; the Blue and White are the two branches of the great African river

explanation.surface: Resembling a pale blossom.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the Nile, whose two main tributaries are named Blue and White.

clue.text: Bloomer 'about the army being detailed to shift this weapon

indicators.note: the bloom word goes around the rearranged letters

parts.note: a bloomer is something that blooms, a flower

indicators.note: shifting letters moves them into a new order
detailed means cut off at the tail, losing the last letter

explanation.surface: A gaffe about soldiers being assigned to move a weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' suggests a blunder, but it is a flower. 'detailed' gives ARM; 'to shift' rearranges THE ARM as AMETHR.
explanation.definitionFit: A weapon that projects burning fuel.
